<!-- pr-reviewer: b17b168d2d66d58a9b3011c8b0b44a70eaf680af -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`: merges at the cut).

**What looks good**
- A welded face is expanded from the model's own `feature::patches` member list, so strips cannot be dropped or invented; each strip goes through the same pick rule as a planar pick (`check_pickable`, planar-only, plane, closed outer ring), so a non-planar or open strip is refused by name (`sinker_faces.rs` `faces_of`/`face_of`).
- `welded_wall` (`sinker_cavity.rs`) refuses an empty weld, and any strip with |nz| > 1e-6 (leaning or level), naming the patch, the strip and the angle; nothing is approximated. `cavity_of` still checks that the walls close around the floor ring, so a strip that does not stand on the floor edge is refused by the existing "walls do not close" rule.
- A patch picked beside its own strips only covers the same floor edge twice; the pin proves the electrode is identical. No panic paths added (no unwrap/index).
- Existing sinker goldens untouched; decision file present; no new deps, no process files.

**Results (merged with current upstream/main, locally on m5)**
- `camcraft-motion --lib sinker`: 36 passed
- `camcraft-app` `sinker_electrode` 8, `sinker_electrode_body` 6, `sinker_electrode_mcp` 14, `sinker_undersize` 2, `sinker_burn` 10: all passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The old test pinning "a welded corner is refused as a curved wall" is rewritten to the new behaviour; the strip/leaning/level/empty refusals are pinned in `sinker_electrode_tests.rs`.
- Synthetic only, no real EDM control run (stated in the decision file).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
